revervox_mod.configuration.title: Revervox Configs
revervox_mod.configuration.revervoxMaxAu: Maximum audios that Revervox will play before disappearing
revervox_mod.configuration.revervoxGrace: Time in seconds that Revervox will wait after speaking before being able to get angry

Time in seconds that Revervox Bat will wait after spawn before being able to get angry
revervox_mod.configuration.revervoxBatSp: Chance of Revervox Bat spawning (1 in x)
revervox_mod.configuration.revervoxSword: How much extra damage the Revervox sword deals to revervox entities
revervox_mod.configuration.batToothDropC: The chance of a Revervox Bat dropping its tooth on attack (1 in x)
revervox_mod.configuration.batEventChanc: Chance of fake bat event occuring. Higher is less likely, lower is more likely
revervox_mod.configuration.revervoxBlock: Whether Revervox breaks blocks to get to you
revervox_mod.configuration.revervoxBreak: Whether Revervox breaks non-solid blocks such as torches and leaves
revervox_mod.configuration.maxSavedRecor: The maximum amount of player recordings that can be saved
revervox_mod.configuration.minimumAudioC: The minimum amount of audios before they start being deleted
revervox_mod.configuration.revervoxSonic: Whether Revervox uses the Sonic Boom ability
Cooldown (in seconds) between Revervox Sonic Booms
Range (in blocks) of Revervox's Sonic Boom
